tools.name: web_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch any public web page and return clean Markdown (main article content by default, or the full page). Renders JavaScript-heavy pages in headless Chromium automatically when needed. Returns title, byline, markdown.

tools.name: web_links
tools.description: Extract all links (internal/external, anchor text), title, description, OpenGraph image, canonical URL and RSS/Atom feeds from a web page.

tools.name: pdf_to_text
tools.description: Download a PDF from a URL (up to 25 MB) and extract its text layer, page count, title and author.

tools.name: image_ocr
tools.description: OCR: extract text from an image URL (PNG/JPEG/GIF/TIFF/WebP). Languages: eng, deu, fra, spa, ita, por (join with +).
